mapper.select: SELECT bank_user_id, name, email, password, user_token, user_key_hash, issued_at, created_at, updated_at, birth_date FROM bank_user WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT bank_user_id, name, email, password, user_token, user_key_hash, issued_at, created_at, updated_at, birth_date FROM bank_user WHERE user_token = #{userToken}
SELECT bank_user_id, name, email, password, user_token, user_key_hash, issued_at, created_at, updated_at, birth_date FROM bank_user WHERE bank_user_id = #{bankUserId}
mapper.update: UPDATE bank_user SET pending_user_key = #{pendingUserKey}, key_status = 'PENDING', pending_issued_at = #{pendingIssuedAt}, pending_expires_at = #{pendingExpiresAt} WHERE bank_user_id = #{bankUserId} AND (key_status IS NULL OR key_status != 'PENDING' OR pending_expires_at < NOW())

UPDATE bank_user SET user_key_hash = pending_user_key, issued_at = pending_issued_at, key_status = 'ACTIVE', pending_user_key = NULL, pending_issued_at = NULL, pending_expires_at = NULL WHERE pending_user_key = #{hashedKey} AND key_status = 'PENDING' AND pending_expires_at > NOW()

UPDATE bank_user SET key_status = 'EXPIRED', pending_user_key = NULL, pending_issued_at = NULL, pending_expires_at = NULL WHERE bank_user_id = #{bankUserId} AND key_status = 'PENDING' AND pending_issued_at = #{pendingIssuedAt}
UPDATE bank_user SET key_status = 'EXPIRED', user_key_hash = NULL, pending_user_key = NULL, pending_issued_at = NULL, pending_expires_at = NULL WHERE user_key_hash = #{hashedKey}
